name: ClickHouse
description: SQL access to a ClickHouse database.
setup: Your credentials stay on this server. Queries are read-only. Enable read-write to also allow explicit write operations. Use a database role limited to the data and operations you want to share.

config_fields.name: protocol
config_fields.label: Protocol
config_fields.help: Use the matching endpoint from your ClickHouse Connect dialog: https://user:pass@host:8443/db for HTTPS, or clickhouse://user:pass@host:9440/db for Native TLS.
